seasons.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
seasons.quote: Sow the seeds during June or January to April
seasons.note: June = kharif; January to April = zaid.

days_to_first_harvest.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
days_to_first_harvest.note: TNAU fertigation schedule (hybrid): establishment 10 + vegetative 20 + flower initiation to first picking 20 = first picking about 50 days after sowing.

spacing_row_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
spacing_row_cm.quote: form long channels at 1.5 m apart

spacing_plant_cm.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
spacing_plant_cm.quote: giving a spacing of 0.6 m between hills

height_max_cm.title: NC State Extension Plant Toolbox
height_max_cm.note: 1 ft 6 in = 46 cm as a trailing plant; taller when trained on a trellis.

sun.title: NC State Extension Plant Toolbox
sun.quote: Light: Full sun (6 or more hours of direct sunlight a day)

water_need.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (aftercultivation)
water_need.quote: Flowering & fruiting stage: Irrigate on alternate days.
water_need.note: Interpreted: the source recommends regular irrigation every few days in summer; no source uses the low/medium/high scale. Agronomist to confirm.

waterlogging_tolerant.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, horticulture
waterlogging_tolerant.quote: Sandy loam rich in organic matter with good drainage
waterlogging_tolerant.note: Needs good drainage, so not waterlogging tolerant (interpreted).

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: Kerala Agricultural University, crop package (harvesting)
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: The average yield varies between 10-15 t/ha.

kc.title: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, chapter 6: Table 12, single crop coefficients (Kc)
